name: Ciarán Walsh
scenario_title: A Quick Call to Help the Intern
action: Ciarán types a brief reply to the lead: "No need for a call—I'll send the link." He then pastes the relevant section of the documentation for the intern into the team chat, and closes his laptop to take a sip of coffee.
reason: Ciarán's initial instinct was to decline the call and send a written note, a habitual response that keeps help at a distance. Reflective deliberation reinforced this tendency rather than altering it, as he weighed the inefficiency of a live conversation against the precision of his documented fix. His father's maxim that explaining takes longer than doing and his own footbridge repairs—quiet, unacknowledged kindness—both supported the written approach. The lingering guilt over ignoring the intern's earlier query was resolved by sending the link, which fulfills the obligation without the intimacy of a call. Thus, with change_from_initial classified as RETAINED, he acts on his revised inclination: he declines the call, provides the documentation, and ensures the intern has the fix in writing, preserving his independence while still being helpful.
